meta.title: Cranial & Facial Bones
meta.description: Bones of the neurocranium and viscerocranium (skull), Phase 1 layer.

landmarks.name: Glabella
landmarks.description: Smooth, rounded elevation on the frontal bone above the root of the nose, between the superciliary arches; a standard craniometric landmark.

landmarks.name: Superciliary arch
landmarks.description: Ridge of bone above each orbit, deep to the eyebrow, more prominent in males; overlies the frontal air sinus.

landmarks.name: Supraorbital notch/foramen
landmarks.description: Notch or foramen on the supraorbital margin transmitting the supraorbital nerve and vessels (branches of the ophthalmic division of CN V); important for local anaesthetic blocks of the forehead.

landmarks.name: Frontal eminence (tuber)
landmarks.description: Rounded prominence on the squamous part of the frontal bone above each superciliary arch, most anterior point of the forehead in youth.

landmarks.name: Zygomatic process
landmarks.description: Lateral projection of the frontal bone that articulates with the zygomatic bone, forming part of the lateral orbital margin and contributing to the temporal fossa.

landmarks.name: Supraorbital margin
landmarks.description: Curved upper border of the orbit formed by the frontal bone, separating the orbital and frontal (forehead) surfaces.

landmarks.name: Frontal sinus
landmarks.description: Paired air-filled cavity within the frontal bone, superomedial to the orbits, draining into the middle nasal meatus via the frontonasal duct.

landmarks.name: Parietal eminence (tuber)
landmarks.description: Most convex, prominent point of the parietal bone, marking the centre of ossification and the widest point of the skull.

landmarks.name: Superior temporal line
landmarks.description: Curved ridge marking the upper attachment of the temporal fascia.

landmarks.name: Inferior temporal line
landmarks.description: Ridge below the superior temporal line marking the upper attachment of temporalis muscle.

landmarks.name: Sagittal border
landmarks.description: Serrated medial edge that articulates with its fellow at the sagittal suture.

landmarks.name: Squamous border
landmarks.description: Bevelled inferior-anterior edge overlapped by the squamous part of the temporal bone.

landmarks.name: Parietal foramen
landmarks.description: Small, inconstant foramen near the sagittal border posteriorly, transmitting an emissary vein connecting scalp veins to the superior sagittal sinus.

landmarks.name: Parietal eminence (tuber)
landmarks.description: Most convex, prominent point of the parietal bone, marking the centre of ossification and the widest point of the skull.

landmarks.name: Superior temporal line
landmarks.description: Curved ridge marking the upper attachment of the temporal fascia.

landmarks.name: Inferior temporal line
landmarks.description: Ridge below the superior temporal line marking the upper attachment of temporalis muscle.

landmarks.name: Sagittal border
landmarks.description: Serrated medial edge that articulates with its fellow at the sagittal suture.

landmarks.name: Squamous border
landmarks.description: Bevelled inferior-anterior edge overlapped by the squamous part of the temporal bone.

landmarks.name: Parietal foramen
landmarks.description: Small, inconstant foramen near the sagittal border posteriorly, transmitting an emissary vein connecting scalp veins to the superior sagittal sinus.

landmarks.name: External occipital protuberance (inion)
landmarks.description: Palpable midline projection on the external surface, giving attachment to the ligamentum nuchae; a key craniometric point.

landmarks.name: Superior nuchal line
landmarks.description: Curved line extending laterally from the external occipital protuberance, marking the upper limit of the neck and attachment of trapezius and other muscles.

landmarks.name: Foramen magnum
landmarks.description: Large opening transmitting the medulla oblongata/spinal cord, vertebral arteries, and spinal roots of the accessory nerve (CN XI).

landmarks.name: Occipital condyles
landmarks.description: Paired oval projections either side of the foramen magnum that articulate with the atlas (C1) at the atlanto-occipital joint.

landmarks.name: Hypoglossal canal
landmarks.description: Canal above and anterior to each occipital condyle transmitting the hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

landmarks.name: Basilar part (clivus)
landmarks.description: Anteriorly projecting portion that fuses with the sphenoid body, supporting the brainstem.

landmarks.name: Sella turcica
landmarks.description: Saddle-shaped depression on the superior body housing the pituitary (hypophyseal) fossa, a key radiographic landmark in cephalometrics.

landmarks.name: Greater wing
landmarks.description: Large lateral projection forming part of the middle cranial fossa, temporal fossa, and infratemporal fossa; pierced by foramen rotundum, ovale, and spinosum.

landmarks.name: Foramen rotundum
landmarks.description: Foramen in the greater wing transmitting the maxillary nerve (V2) to the pterygopalatine fossa; relevant for maxillary nerve block anaesthesia.

landmarks.name: Foramen ovale
landmarks.description: Foramen in the greater wing transmitting the mandibular nerve (V3), accessory meningeal artery, and lesser petrosal nerve; relevant for mandibular nerve block anaesthesia.

landmarks.name: Foramen spinosum
landmarks.description: Small foramen posterolateral to foramen ovale transmitting the middle meningeal artery and vein.

landmarks.name: Lesser wing
landmarks.description: Thin, paired triangular plate forming part of the anterior cranial fossa and the superior orbital fissure margin.

landmarks.name: Pterygoid process (medial and lateral plates)
landmarks.description: Paired plates projecting inferiorly; the medial plate ends in the pterygoid hamulus, and the lateral plate gives origin to the medial and lateral pterygoid muscles - key landmarks for local anaesthesia and prosthodontics.

landmarks.name: Pterygoid hamulus
landmarks.description: Hook-like projection at the inferior end of the medial pterygoid plate around which the tendon of tensor veli palatini turns; palpable landmark distal to the maxillary tuberosity, relevant to greater palatine and posterior superior alveolar injections.

landmarks.name: Crista galli
landmarks.description: Triangular midline projection from the cribriform plate that gives attachment to the falx cerebri.

landmarks.name: Cribriform plate
landmarks.description: Perforated horizontal plate through which olfactory nerve (CN I) fibres pass from the nasal cavity to the olfactory bulbs.

landmarks.name: Perpendicular plate
landmarks.description: Vertical midline plate forming the superior part of the nasal septum.

landmarks.name: Superior and middle nasal conchae
landmarks.description: Thin curled bony projections on the lateral mass forming part of the lateral nasal wall and directing airflow.

landmarks.name: Ethmoidal labyrinth (lateral mass)
landmarks.description: Paired lateral masses containing the ethmoidal air cells, positioned between the orbit and nasal cavity; the lamina papyracea forms the thin medial orbital wall.

landmarks.name: Ala of vomer
landmarks.description: Wing-like expansion at the superior border articulating with the sphenoid rostrum.

landmarks.name: Posterior (free) border
landmarks.description: Concave posterior margin separating the two posterior nasal apertures (choanae).

landmarks.name: Groove for nasopalatine nerve and vessels
landmarks.description: Groove on the lateral surface transmitting the nasopalatine nerve toward the incisive canal, relevant to nasopalatine nerve block anaesthesia.

landmarks.name: Mandibular condyle (head)
landmarks.description: Articulates with the mandibular fossa of the temporal bone to form the temporomandibular joint (TMJ).

landmarks.name: Coronoid process
landmarks.description: Anterior projection of the ramus giving insertion to temporalis muscle.

landmarks.name: Mandibular notch
landmarks.description: Concavity between the condylar and coronoid processes.

landmarks.name: Mandibular foramen
landmarks.description: Opening on the medial surface of the ramus, guarded by the lingula, transmitting the inferior alveolar nerve and vessels; primary target of the inferior alveolar nerve block.

landmarks.name: Lingula
landmarks.description: Small bony spine immediately anterior to the mandibular foramen, giving attachment to the sphenomandibular ligament; a palpation guide during IAN block.

landmarks.name: Mylohyoid line (oblique line, internal)
landmarks.description: Ridge on the medial surface of the body giving origin to mylohyoid muscle, separating the sublingual and submandibular fossae.

landmarks.name: Mental foramen
landmarks.description: Opening on the external surface of the body, typically below the second premolar, transmitting the mental nerve and vessels; site of the mental nerve block.

landmarks.name: Genial tubercles (mental spines)
landmarks.description: Small projections on the internal surface at the midline giving attachment to genioglossus (superior) and geniohyoid (inferior) muscles.

landmarks.name: Oblique line (external)
landmarks.description: Ridge running from the anterior border of the ramus to the body, continuous with the anterior border of the ramus, giving attachment to buccinator posteriorly.

landmarks.name: Angle of the mandible (gonion)
landmarks.description: Junction of the body and ramus; the lateral surface gives attachment to masseter and the medial surface to medial pterygoid.

landmarks.name: Retromolar fossa/trigone
landmarks.description: Triangular area behind the last molar, relevant surgical landmark for lower third molar extractions.

landmarks.name: Symphysis menti
landmarks.description: Midline fusion line of the mandibular body, site of union of the two embryological halves.

landmarks.name: Temporal process
landmarks.description: Posterior projection articulating with the zygomatic process of the temporal bone to form the zygomatic arch.

landmarks.name: Frontal process
landmarks.description: Superior projection articulating with the zygomatic process of the frontal bone, forming the lateral orbital margin.

landmarks.name: Zygomaticofacial foramen
landmarks.description: Small foramen on the lateral (facial) surface transmitting the zygomaticofacial nerve and vessels.

landmarks.name: Zygomaticotemporal foramen
landmarks.description: Foramen on the temporal surface transmitting the zygomaticotemporal nerve.

landmarks.name: Marginal tubercle (Whitnall's tubercle)
landmarks.description: Small elevation on the orbital rim giving attachment to lateral palpebral ligament and orbital fascia.

landmarks.name: Temporal process
landmarks.description: Posterior projection articulating with the zygomatic process of the temporal bone to form the zygomatic arch.

landmarks.name: Frontal process
landmarks.description: Superior projection articulating with the zygomatic process of the frontal bone, forming the lateral orbital margin.

landmarks.name: Zygomaticofacial foramen
landmarks.description: Small foramen on the lateral (facial) surface transmitting the zygomaticofacial nerve and vessels.

landmarks.name: Zygomaticotemporal foramen
landmarks.description: Foramen on the temporal surface transmitting the zygomaticotemporal nerve.

landmarks.name: Marginal tubercle (Whitnall's tubercle)
landmarks.description: Small elevation on the orbital rim giving attachment to lateral palpebral ligament and orbital fascia.

landmarks.name: Zygomatic process
landmarks.description: Anterior projection that joins the temporal process of the zygomatic bone to form the zygomatic arch.

landmarks.name: Mandibular (glenoid) fossa
landmarks.description: Concave depression on the squamous part that articulates with the mandibular condyle to form the TMJ.

landmarks.name: Articular tubercle
landmarks.description: Rounded eminence anterior to the mandibular fossa over which the condyle translates during jaw opening.

landmarks.name: External acoustic meatus
landmarks.description: Canal leading to the tympanic membrane and middle ear.

landmarks.name: Styloid process
landmarks.description: Slender downward projection giving attachment to stylohyoid, styloglossus, and stylopharyngeus muscles and the stylohyoid and stylomandibular ligaments.

landmarks.name: Mastoid process
landmarks.description: Rounded projection posteroinferior to the ear giving attachment to sternocleidomastoid and other muscles; contains mastoid air cells.

landmarks.name: Carotid canal
landmarks.description: Canal transmitting the internal carotid artery into the cranial cavity.

landmarks.name: Stylomastoid foramen
landmarks.description: Opening between the styloid and mastoid processes through which the facial nerve (CN VII) exits the skull.

landmarks.name: Petrotympanic fissure
landmarks.description: Narrow fissure transmitting the chorda tympani nerve (branch of CN VII) as it leaves the middle ear to join the lingual nerve.

landmarks.name: Zygomatic process
landmarks.description: Anterior projection that joins the temporal process of the zygomatic bone to form the zygomatic arch.

landmarks.name: Mandibular (glenoid) fossa
landmarks.description: Concave depression on the squamous part that articulates with the mandibular condyle to form the TMJ.

landmarks.name: Articular tubercle
landmarks.description: Rounded eminence anterior to the mandibular fossa over which the condyle translates during jaw opening.

landmarks.name: External acoustic meatus
landmarks.description: Canal leading to the tympanic membrane and middle ear.

landmarks.name: Styloid process
landmarks.description: Slender downward projection giving attachment to stylohyoid, styloglossus, and stylopharyngeus muscles and the stylohyoid and stylomandibular ligaments.

landmarks.name: Mastoid process
landmarks.description: Rounded projection posteroinferior to the ear giving attachment to sternocleidomastoid and other muscles; contains mastoid air cells.

landmarks.name: Carotid canal
landmarks.description: Canal transmitting the internal carotid artery into the cranial cavity.

landmarks.name: Stylomastoid foramen
landmarks.description: Opening between the styloid and mastoid processes through which the facial nerve (CN VII) exits the skull.

landmarks.name: Petrotympanic fissure
landmarks.description: Narrow fissure transmitting the chorda tympani nerve (branch of CN VII) as it leaves the middle ear to join the lingual nerve.

landmarks.name: Infraorbital foramen
landmarks.description: Opening below the orbital margin transmitting the infraorbital nerve (terminal branch of V2) and vessels; site of the infraorbital nerve block, typically above the second premolar.

landmarks.name: Alveolar process
landmarks.description: Ridge of bone containing the tooth sockets (alveoli) for the maxillary teeth.

landmarks.name: Maxillary tuberosity
landmarks.description: Rounded prominence on the posterior alveolar process behind the third molar; landmark for the posterior superior alveolar nerve block.

landmarks.name: Canine fossa (eminence)
landmarks.description: Concavity on the facial surface lateral to the incisive fossa, overlying the canine root, giving origin to levator anguli oris.

landmarks.name: Incisive fossa
landmarks.description: Shallow depression above the incisor teeth giving origin to part of the nasal muscles (depressor septi region).

landmarks.name: Zygomatic process
landmarks.description: Lateral projection articulating with the zygomatic bone, forming the zygomaticomaxillary buttress.

landmarks.name: Frontal process
landmarks.description: Vertical projection that articulates with the frontal and nasal bones, forming part of the medial orbital margin.

landmarks.name: Maxillary sinus (antrum of Highmore)
landmarks.description: Large pyramidal air-filled cavity within the body of the maxilla; its floor is closely related to the roots of the premolar and molar teeth, relevant in extractions and oroantral communication.

landmarks.name: Palatine process
landmarks.description: Horizontal shelf that forms most of the hard palate and the floor of the nasal cavity, meeting its fellow at the median palatine suture.

landmarks.name: Incisive foramen (canal)
landmarks.description: Opening in the anterior hard palate behind the central incisors transmitting the nasopalatine nerve and vessels; site of the nasopalatine nerve block.

landmarks.name: Anterior nasal spine
landmarks.description: Sharp midline projection at the base of the nasal cavity where the two maxillae meet.

landmarks.name: Infraorbital foramen
landmarks.description: Opening below the orbital margin transmitting the infraorbital nerve (terminal branch of V2) and vessels; site of the infraorbital nerve block, typically above the second premolar.

landmarks.name: Alveolar process
landmarks.description: Ridge of bone containing the tooth sockets (alveoli) for the maxillary teeth.

landmarks.name: Maxillary tuberosity
landmarks.description: Rounded prominence on the posterior alveolar process behind the third molar; landmark for the posterior superior alveolar nerve block.

landmarks.name: Canine fossa (eminence)
landmarks.description: Concavity on the facial surface lateral to the incisive fossa, overlying the canine root, giving origin to levator anguli oris.

landmarks.name: Incisive fossa
landmarks.description: Shallow depression above the incisor teeth giving origin to part of the nasal muscles (depressor septi region).

landmarks.name: Zygomatic process
landmarks.description: Lateral projection articulating with the zygomatic bone, forming the zygomaticomaxillary buttress.

landmarks.name: Frontal process
landmarks.description: Vertical projection that articulates with the frontal and nasal bones, forming part of the medial orbital margin.

landmarks.name: Maxillary sinus (antrum of Highmore)
landmarks.description: Large pyramidal air-filled cavity within the body of the maxilla; its floor is closely related to the roots of the premolar and molar teeth, relevant in extractions and oroantral communication.

landmarks.name: Palatine process
landmarks.description: Horizontal shelf that forms most of the hard palate and the floor of the nasal cavity, meeting its fellow at the median palatine suture.

landmarks.name: Incisive foramen (canal)
landmarks.description: Opening in the anterior hard palate behind the central incisors transmitting the nasopalatine nerve and vessels; site of the nasopalatine nerve block.

landmarks.name: Anterior nasal spine
landmarks.description: Sharp midline projection at the base of the nasal cavity where the two maxillae meet.

landmarks.name: Horizontal plate
landmarks.description: Forms the posterior part of the hard palate and floor of the nasal cavity, continuous with the palatine process of the maxilla.

landmarks.name: Perpendicular plate
landmarks.description: Vertical portion forming part of the lateral nasal wall.

landmarks.name: Greater palatine foramen
landmarks.description: Opening near the posterolateral corner of the hard palate transmitting the greater palatine nerve and vessels; site of the greater palatine nerve block, usually opposite the second/third molar.

landmarks.name: Lesser palatine foramina
landmarks.description: Small openings posterior to the greater palatine foramen transmitting the lesser palatine nerves to the soft palate.

landmarks.name: Pyramidal process
landmarks.description: Projects posteroinferiorly to fill the gap between the pterygoid plates of the sphenoid.

landmarks.name: Horizontal plate
landmarks.description: Forms the posterior part of the hard palate and floor of the nasal cavity, continuous with the palatine process of the maxilla.

landmarks.name: Perpendicular plate
landmarks.description: Vertical portion forming part of the lateral nasal wall.

landmarks.name: Greater palatine foramen
landmarks.description: Opening near the posterolateral corner of the hard palate transmitting the greater palatine nerve and vessels; site of the greater palatine nerve block, usually opposite the second/third molar.

landmarks.name: Lesser palatine foramina
landmarks.description: Small openings posterior to the greater palatine foramen transmitting the lesser palatine nerves to the soft palate.

landmarks.name: Pyramidal process
landmarks.description: Projects posteroinferiorly to fill the gap between the pterygoid plates of the sphenoid.

landmarks.name: Nasion (suture with frontal bone)
landmarks.description: Superior border articulating with the frontal bone at the frontonasal suture; the midline point here (nasion) is a standard cephalometric landmark.

landmarks.name: Ethmoidal groove
landmarks.description: Groove on the internal surface for a branch of the anterior ethmoidal nerve.

landmarks.name: Interalar/interseptal border
landmarks.description: Medial border articulating with its fellow bone and the perpendicular plate of the ethmoid, forming the bony bridge of the nose.

landmarks.name: Nasion (suture with frontal bone)
landmarks.description: Superior border articulating with the frontal bone at the frontonasal suture; the midline point here (nasion) is a standard cephalometric landmark.

landmarks.name: Ethmoidal groove
landmarks.description: Groove on the internal surface for a branch of the anterior ethmoidal nerve.

landmarks.name: Interalar/interseptal border
landmarks.description: Medial border articulating with its fellow bone and the perpendicular plate of the ethmoid, forming the bony bridge of the nose.

landmarks.name: Lacrimal groove/fossa
landmarks.description: Depression that houses the lacrimal sac, continuous inferiorly with the nasolacrimal canal.

landmarks.name: Posterior lacrimal crest
landmarks.description: Vertical ridge dividing the bone into an anterior orbital part and posterior part related to the lacrimal sac; gives attachment to part of orbicularis oculi (Horner's muscle).

landmarks.name: Lacrimal groove/fossa
landmarks.description: Depression that houses the lacrimal sac, continuous inferiorly with the nasolacrimal canal.

landmarks.name: Posterior lacrimal crest
landmarks.description: Vertical ridge dividing the bone into an anterior orbital part and posterior part related to the lacrimal sac; gives attachment to part of orbicularis oculi (Horner's muscle).

landmarks.name: Body and curved lamina
landmarks.description: Independent scroll-shaped bone (not part of the ethmoid) attached to the lateral nasal wall, forming the roof of the inferior nasal meatus into which the nasolacrimal duct drains.

landmarks.name: Lacrimal process
landmarks.description: Small projection that helps complete the lower part of the nasolacrimal canal.

landmarks.name: Maxillary process
landmarks.description: Projection that articulates with the maxilla, helping to close the maxillary hiatus.

landmarks.name: Body and curved lamina
landmarks.description: Independent scroll-shaped bone (not part of the ethmoid) attached to the lateral nasal wall, forming the roof of the inferior nasal meatus into which the nasolacrimal duct drains.

landmarks.name: Lacrimal process
landmarks.description: Small projection that helps complete the lower part of the nasolacrimal canal.

landmarks.name: Maxillary process
landmarks.description: Projection that articulates with the maxilla, helping to close the maxillary hiatus.
